name: Jean

"Goddess Church " Plato Branch general priest. He is the boss of Kyosuke and Mikado, and has a stuck-up personality.

Arrogant and sometimes childish, but more benevolent than anyone else. Lily's love enemy and rival.

"In the name of the goddess, I'll defeat you."
